data.speaker: sable
data.message: West rig stopped. Its chassis is still cover. One drive remaining.

data.speaker: sable
data.message: East rig stopped. Its chassis is still cover. Both drives are out; seal the work order at the terminal.

data.speaker: sable
data.message: Work order sealed. It specifies clearing beyond the authorised boundary, under a drainage contract. The stop-work receipt went to their dispatcher too. Hold the clearing for the inspectors.

data.speaker: vale
data.message: Contractor response coming down the north track. One machine gun, two pistols. Keep a robot in the clearing; cover from the ridge or logs.

data.speaker: vale
data.message: Second and final squad, from the site-office track. The inspectors are waiting for the armed machines to stop.

data.speaker: morrow
data.message: The inspectors have possession. They can preserve the terminal and count the stumps. Back to the layby. We're not here to settle the data-center application with a gun.
